title: Release manifest
description: packages/<owner>/<name>/versions/<version>-r<revision>.json — one immutable release. Once merged this file is never edited or deleted; a mistake is corrected by publishing a new revision.

version.description: SemVer. The human-facing number; packaging fixes bump revision instead.

revision.description: Counts repackagings of the same source. Revisions run 1,2,3 with no gaps.

entry.description: Archive-relative path of the file a consumer includes, e.g. src/FindText.ks.

engines.description: Which engines this release runs on. Every claim must pass that engine's validation in CI — compatibility is earned, not declared. Values use the #Requires comparison grammar (>=0.0.0.17), NOT SemVer ranges.

capabilities.description: Capability names as #Requires capability spells them. Informational: tooling displays them, nothing enforces them yet.

dependencies.description: owner/name to an npm-style SemVer range (^1.4.0). Deliberately a different grammar from engines.

artifacts.description: One entry per platform. One logical version across platforms: platform-only repackaging is a revision bump, never a version fork.

sha256.description: The artifact's identity. Mirrors need no trust: bytes that do not hash to this are rejected wherever they came from.

sources.description: Places the same bytes can be fetched from, tried in order. Never identity.

setupNote.description: A step the user must perform after installing — a driver install, a one-time registration. Printed by install; performed only by `kpm setup`, which shows the exact command and asks first. install/add/update never run anything from a package, so nothing executes merely because a build resolved a dependency.

message.description: What the step does and why, in plain language. Say so if it is risky.

script.description: Archive-relative path to something the package ships for this step, e.g. native/install-driver.exe. Must resolve inside the package: the path is untrusted input and cannot point elsewhere on the disk. Ship the binary in the package rather than downloading it at setup time, so it is hash-verified like everything else.

arguments.description: Arguments passed exactly as written. No shell, no expansion.

elevate.description: The step needs administrator rights; the user is told before confirming.

reboot.description: The step only takes effect after a restart.

platforms.description: Platforms the step applies to; omitted means all of them.

sourceRef.description: Provenance: where this release's content came from. Not a download location.
